title: 第23章 炎冰斩魄符之威第24章 储物袋一阶法器分配到手
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
“掳人邪修？”
李氏狩猎队，人人自危，面露惊骇。
二长老御剑杀出，说道：“定舟，你带他们突围，老夫拖住他们。”
蒙面男子冷笑道：“老家伙，你们谁也走不了。”
咻！
男子御剑杀出，炼气六层修为注入一阶中品法器中，飞剑更加迅猛，速度更加快捷，实力压制二长老。
二长老李光宗左手一挥，风刃符飞出，风之剑刃一出，杀向男子。
男人以灵识御剑，长剑横空，轻松挡住风刃符，嗤笑道：“区区一阶中品符纸，能奈我何？”
“杀！”
飞剑快若流光，来回凿击二长老。
二长老激活金刚符防御、风刃符杀敌、爆火符反击，短时间内依靠一张张符纸，勉强牵制对方。
“老家伙，你以为只有你有符纸吗？”蒙面男子五指一挥，三张一阶中品符纸飞出，纷纷爆炸开来。
嘭嘭嘭三声后，二长老负伤倒飞数丈。
要不是金刚符护体，他早已重伤。
“去！”男子御剑杀出，一剑击飞二长老的法器，随后飞剑流光一闪，穿透二长老大腿，鲜血飞溅。
“啊！”二长老发出一声惨叫。
随后，蒙面男子快速挥手一抛，一张缚灵网笼罩而下，套住二长老，牢牢禁锢，使其无法反击。
见到这一幕，李定舟几人面色一变：“二长老！”
“该死的，和他们拼了！”
李定舟俯冲杀出，说道：“你们牵制其他人，我去救二长老。”

月影术！
李定舟身影流光，残影随行，化作光影杀出，直奔蒙面男子。
蒙面女子冷笑道：“区区炼气四层，不自量力。”
咻！
女子御剑杀来，攻击李定舟大腿，打算废掉他的行动能力。
李定舟心中盘算：“只有攻其不备，才能速战速决。”
“唯有在炼气六层男子反应过来之前，快速斩杀此女，后期才能与之周旋，保住家族力量。”
“元儿，幸好有你。”
俯冲途中，李定舟快速取出符纸，一张金刚符贴在身上，瞬间激活。
随后发出风刃符、爆火符，他一出手，便是三张符纸。
这其中，金刚符是质量精品的一阶中品符纸，可以抵御炼气六层修士攻击。
他打出的风刃符、爆火符，也都属于精品，攻击力堪比炼气六层全力一击。
content_en:
"A kidnapping evil cultivator?"
Everyone in Li's hunting team felt in danger and looked horrified.
The second elder came out with his sword and said: "Dingzhou, you lead them to break out, I will hold them back."
The masked man sneered: "Old guy, none of you can leave."
Phew!
The man charged out with his sword, and the sixth level of Qi refining was injected into the first-order mid-grade magic weapon. The flying sword became more fierce and faster, and his strength suppressed the second elder.
The second elder Li Guangzong waved his left hand, the wind blade talisman flew out, and the wind blade came out and killed the man.
The man used his spiritual sense to control the sword, and the long sword flew across the air, easily blocking the wind blade talisman, and sneered: "It's just a first-order middle-grade talisman paper, what can you do to me?"
"Kill!"
The flying sword was as fast as a stream of light, striking the second elder back and forth.
The second elder activated the diamond talisman to defend, the wind blade talisman to kill the enemy, and the explosive talisman to counterattack. In a short period of time, he could barely contain the opponent by relying on the talismans.
"Old guy, do you think you are the only one who has the talisman?" The masked man waved his five fingers, and three first-level middle-grade talismans flew out and exploded one after another.
After three bang bang bang sounds, the second elder was injured and flew several feet away.
If it weren't for the diamond talisman, he would have been seriously injured.
"Go!" The man charged out with his sword and knocked away the second elder's magic weapon with one strike. Then the flying sword flashed and penetrated the second elder's thigh, causing blood to splash.
"Ah!" The second elder screamed.
Then, the masked man quickly waved his hand, and a spirit-binding net came down, trapping the second elder and imprisoning him tightly, making him unable to fight back.
Seeing this scene, the expressions of Li Dingzhou and others changed: "Second Elder!"
"Damn it, fight them!"
Li Dingzhou swooped out and said, "You restrain the others while I go rescue the second elder."
Moon Shadow Technique!
Li Dingzhou's figure faded, and his shadow followed him. He turned into light and shadow and rushed out, heading straight for the masked man.
The masked woman sneered and said: "You are only at the fourth level of Qi Refining, you are not overestimating your own abilities."
Phew!
The woman came with a sword and attacked Li Dingzhou's thigh, intending to cripple his ability to move.
Li Dingzhou thought in his mind: "Only by attacking the enemy unprepared can we achieve a quick victory."
"Only by quickly killing this woman before the man on the sixth level of Qi Refining reacts can we deal with her later and preserve the family's power."
"Yuan'er, I'm lucky to have you."
During the dive, Li Dingzhou quickly took out the talisman and put a diamond talisman on his body, which was instantly activated.
Then he released the wind blade talisman and the explosive fire talisman. As soon as he took action, there were three talisman papers.
Among them, the diamond talisman is a high-quality first-level mid-grade talisman paper that can resist the attacks of the sixth-level Qi refining monks.
The wind blade talisman and explosive fire talisman he played were also of high quality, and their attack power was comparable to a full blow from the sixth level of Qi Refining.
